title: Small-query seed CNF construction
statement: Let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $	ext{proofLength}$, and $r>0$ query positions, and let $s$ be a seed of its verifier. The construction produces a CNF formula on $r+r2^r$ variables with exactly $r2^r$ clauses: in order, these are the lifted clauses of the seed acceptance CNF, followed by copies of its first clause if it is nonempty; if it is empty, the clauses are the prescribed filler clauses.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system over the Boolean alphabet, with input length $n$, proof length $\text{proofLength}$, and $r$ query positions
$s$ is a seed of the verifier
